721400101.text: People from abroad, come and have a look! This is the best Jakotsu Crystal in Yashiori Island!

721400102.text: C'mon, check it out! Goods of this quality used to go straight to the Shogunate. Get it at a discount here, Adventurers, and you'll be making weapons that'll cut through steel like butter in no time!

721400104.text: Well, let me see... Five crystals for 300,000 Mora, 15 crystals for 900,000 Mora, a batch of 30 crystals for... 1.8 million Mora. Thanks for your patronage!

721400106.text: Might as well commit daylight robbery!

721400109.text: Haha, I get it. For you outlanders, so far away from home, it's gotta be hard to part with your Mora.

721400110.text: After all, the mine's been shut down because of the war, and there's this Tatarigami or whatever causing a nuisance on the island. That's what the grown-ups say anyway...

721400111.text: Well, my own supplies are running low. Scarcity drives prices up, y'know?

721400112.text: Besides, this stuff contains a "risk premium," too~

721400115.text: Well... I'm a kid making money like an adult, so I run the risk of discovery by the Tenryou Commission — that's what I mean by "risk premium"!

721400108.text: Hey! What's that supposed to mean?

721400201.text: You're back. Do you have the crystals with you?

subQuests.subQuestName: Give the Crystal Marrow to Chouji

721400302.text: Alright then, time to tell us where the treasure is.

721400303.text: Okay. The treasure is just next to the mine. You'll find it, easy-peasy.

subQuests.subQuestName: Obtain the treasure mentioned by Chouji

721400405.text: Ugh... Oh, I'll be honest with you. We're a mining family, so we were already very poor. And now that all these things have happened, life's gotten even harder...

721400406.text: I'm just a poor boy from a poor family. I've never seen a large sum of Mora in my life...

721400407.text: Those things I gave you are the only precious treasures I have...

721400412.text: How much do 30 pieces of crystal cost...?

subQuests.subQuestName: Rest until 11:00 – 14:00 the next day and talk to Chouji

721402701.text: Hmmm... You don't seem to have had that much experience in the kitchen, but the food's still really good. Thank you!

721402702.text: #Hmph, {NICKNAME}'s culinary skill needs no praise! Hey, save some for Paimon!

721400501.text: Wow, didn't expect to see you again. Hello there!

721400502.text: Are you here to buy crystals today, too?

721400506.text: Come have a look at today's crystals. These were supposed to go straight to Tatarasuna!

721400507.text: You won't be disappointed, trust me!

721400509.text: Fool Paimon twice, shame on Paimon!

721400517.text: So you've been selling ore alone here this whole time?

721400518.text: Yeah! I grew up, and started making Mora! Only kids are scared of being alone.

721400519.text: But didn't you that say your parents are here too?

721400525.text: #So, {NICKNAME}, you promised to help me before, didn't you?

721400513.text: Not bad. Thanks for your concern!

721400514.text: It used to be pretty lively on the island, but ever since the war started, everyone's moved out... even the mine's all empty now.

721400515.text: Some moved north, others went south, and no one's come back yet... It's so quiet now.

721400516.text: But that's not necessarily a bad thing, huh? It's annoying with too many little kiddos around, and I'm not a kid anymore... I mean, adults should look after themselves and make their own fun, right?

721400601.text: #Oh, {NICKNAME}, you're back. Did you bring the crystals?

subQuests.subQuestName: Give the Crystal Marrow to Chouji

721400701.text: Thank you! That should be enough.

721400702.text: So, where's that explanation we wanted?

721400707.text: People either left or got sick... There aren't many people on Yashiori Island anymore.

721400708.text: ...I don't want to have to fight every day. I don't want to be surrounded by all this Tatarigami... I wanna get away from here. Leave this island.

721400710.text: Yeah, are you going to leave your parents alone here?

721400711.text: Like I said... They're in a safe place.

721400712.text: #...{NICKNAME}, could we talk about this unhappy stuff later?

721400713.text: Haha, don't worry. I won't run away.

721400714.text: #How about this then... If you've got time, {NICKNAME}, you should come over to my place. We can continue our talk there!

721400715.text: Hey! Don't just leave! We haven't said anything yet!

721400801.text: #{NICKNAME}! I didn't think you'd actually come...

721400803.text: How is it? Not bad, huh?

721400806.text: Oh, I'm so sorry! I invited you to my house, but I forgot to cook... Sorry, that's my bad.

721400807.text: Not that I've got much left now other than Lavender Melon...

721400808.text: I'm used to eating those, but I can't just serve them to guests...

721400809.text: Well, just a moment, please. I'll go collect some ingredients so that I can make something for you.

721400810.text: Well, Paimon's not waiting around for that. We'll come along and help!

subQuests.subQuestName: Learn how to make Imported Poultry

721401002.text: All right, let's not dilly-dally any longer. Let's make us some Imported Poultry!

721401006.text: Haha, alright. Now, let me introduce the recipe to you!

721401017.text: You're a pretty talented cook, Chouji.

721401018.text: Paimon didn't know you were such a good cook, either! Ooh, Paimon's stomach is already rumbling just listening to those instructions.

721401019.text: Well, this is the recipe my mom taught me. It's her signature dish.

721401020.text: Hehe, let's try and make it, shall we?

721401021.text: My mom always used to teach me to cook. This is the first time that I'm teaching someone else!

721401022.text: #{NICKNAME}, you're a great adventurer, right? I'm sure this Imported Poultry is just a piece of cake for you!

721401023.text: Ooh, Paimon's mad now, he's looking down on us!

721401007.text: This dish is very easy to make! First, let's cut the Lavender Melon and boil it in water. Then, we crack the Bird Eggs and beat them.

721401008.text: If you're confident enough with a knife, you can cut the melons into any shape you like!

721401009.text: Next, put the Fowl on the chopping board and slice it down the middle into thick pieces. Then, we need to marinate it for a while...

721401010.text: After that, we'll dredge the sliced Fowl through the flour... If there's too much flour, remember to pat it off. Then, we coat the Fowl evenly using the beaten eggs.

721401011.text: Heat the oil — and don't forget to use a chopstick to test the temperature. You'll know it's ready once you see small bubbles gushing up from the chopstick.

721401012.text: Then, put the slices that have been wrapped in flour into the pan and deep fry them for, um, three to four minutes. Turn the heat up until the skin turns golden, and then you can take them out.

721401013.text: Don't heat the oil too much, or else it'll be overcooked. But if it's not hot enough, the oil will seep into the skin and make it soft, which will make it taste horrible.

721401014.text: Take the deep-fried Fowl out and put it on top of paper to soak up the extra oil. Then cut it into strips.

721401015.text: Finally, decorate it with lavender melon, add some homemade sauce... and we're done!

subQuests.subQuestName: Share the dish you made with Chouji

721400901.text: What we'll need is some <color=#00E1FFFF>Flour</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>Fowl</color>, and <color=#00E1FFFF>Bird Eggs</color>. Just ask me any time if you forget!

subQuests.subQuestName: Ask Chouji about the taste of the dish

721401208.text: #Mm~mm! That's yummy! {NICKNAME}, you have the potential to become a famous chef!

721401209.text: #Wow, it smells good! You know what, {NICKNAME}, why don't we just open a gourmet kiosk here?

subQuests.subQuestName: Ask Chouji about the taste of the dish
Ask Chouji about the taste of the dish

721402601.text: Uh... Ahaha, I've got to say that I've never tasted such... outlandish flavors in my life.

721402602.text: Outlandish flavors? More like Abyssal ones!

721402603.text: Come on, Chouji, don't force yourself! You're still a kid. You don't have to eat this stuff...

721401301.text: Thank you. I haven't had this dish for a long time. My mom used to cook this for me. It was so delicious... no one could make it as well as her.

721401302.text: Well, now I wish I wasn't stuck eating lavender melon every day. I wish I could eat poultry dishes every day.

721401306.text: I wouldn't if it was cooked by my mom.

721401308.text: I'm working hard to save money so that I can leave Yashiori Island, try more delicious food, and make yummy dishes for more people!

721401309.text: It's said that only one round-trip route to Snezhnaya is still open in Ritou... Maybe I still have a chance.

721401310.text: The grown-ups say that as long as I have enough Mora, even the Commissioner will let us go out to sea.

721402002.text: Wait a minute. Let Paimon guess what you're about to say...

721402005.text: That's what you are going to say, right!

721402007.text: How have your travels been going?

721402008.text: Good. But I still haven't found any trace of my Mom...

721402009.text: #It doesn't matter. We'll help you, too, right, {NICKNAME}?

721402011.text: #Mm! I knew I could rely on you, {NICKNAME}!

721401603.text: Unfortunately, your mother didn't leave any messages there...

721401605.text: But someone did leave a lot of Sakura Bloom petals there.

721401606.text: It's the flowers your mother offered.

721401608.text: Sorry, Chouji. We couldn't find any more information...

721401610.text: #Thank you for your hard work over these last few days, {NICKNAME}.

721401611.text: Now... I need to figure out what to do next.

721401613.text: Well... Thanks, but I won't. We don't trust the city folk.

721401615.text: Thanks, but I don't want to trouble you anymore.

721401616.text: And... I don't want to be taken care of.

721401617.text: The kid is very grown-up for his age...

721401618.text: It's not like that... It's just that... I've lost the person that I relied on, and I don't want to rely on others. That's all.

721401619.text: #{NICKNAME}, if you've got family you're looking for, you should be able to understand me, right?

721401705.text: Paimon, gunning for an extra meal, are you?

721401706.text: Of course. Paimon could always go for an extra meal!

721401707.text: You misunderstand. I mean you're the extra meal.

721401710.text: All right, all right, you guys, please stop fighting.

721401711.text: I'm doing fine. But I'd like to ask you for another favor.

721401714.text: #Well, it's nothing special. I just need you to help me get some more crystals, {NICKNAME}.

721401715.text: Believe me, I'll reward you for your help... As long as you trust me.

721401201.text: Are you done? Let's have a try!

721401203.text: Uh... Ahaha, I've got to say that I've never tasted such... outlandish flavors in my life.

721401204.text: Outlandish flavors? More like Abyssal ones!

721401205.text: Come on, Chouji, don't force yourself! You're still a kid. You don't have to eat this stuff...

721401206.text: Hmmm... You don't seem to have had that much experience in the kitchen, but the food's still really good. Thank you!

721401207.text: #Humph, {NICKNAME}'s culinary skill needs no praise! Hey, save some for Paimon!

721401901.text: This should be enough Crystal Marrow. Now it's time to start my adventure!

721401902.text: Paimon's still worried about this kid...

721401906.text: Hey, Chouji, you'd better stop running your mouth! You should feel lucky that you met us... otherwise, you'd get beaten up!

721401907.text: Also, in case any bad guys want to fish for any information from you, be sure not to tell them the truth! Make up a story!

721401909.text: Paimon's turning into a naggy old granny.

721401910.text: Anyone would be worried if a little kid like him went out on an adventure all by himself!

721401913.text: Hahahaha! Thank you, thank you both!

721401915.text: Promise Paimon that you'll stay safe...

721401917.text: Next, I'll head to Tatarasuna, where Mom used to work. Maybe someone can tell me if she's been there.

721401918.text: And then... I'll try to go to Narukami Island and travel to Snezhnaya via merchant ship. After that, I'll just see how things go.

721402301.text: #Hey there, {NICKNAME}, I didn't expect I'd see you again!

721402302.text: Long time no see! How's the world outside of Yashiori Island?

721402303.text: It's a lot wealthier than my hometown. They have a lot of good food and fun things to do. But... I can't say that I really like it.

721402305.text: The people here all seem to be missing something...

721402306.text: When we used to live in Yashiori Island, Her Excellency was a distant yet calming presence to us... We didn't care where she was, but we believed that she was right there, watching us, protecting us, deciding how we should live our lives and what kind of people we should become...

721402307.text: But here, Her Excellency covers everything and oppresses everything...

721402308.text: *sigh* I'm not really sure how to put it...

721402309.text: By the way, have you found anything concerning my mother?

721402311.text: It's okay. Tell me when you have any news.

721402501.text: Anyway. Thank you for your help! See you around!

721402502.text: #Well, I don't know when I'll see you again next. I hope you'll still remember me by then, {NICKNAME}!

721401101.text: #Woohoo! Alright then, {NICKNAME}, you can start now!

721401402.text: Why don't you eat something, or drink some water?

721401501.text: This is probably the shrine that Chouji mentioned, huh?

721401502.text: (It looks like an ordinary shrine — there is a distinct lack of any strange elemental traces.)

721401504.text: (The shrine is simple but elegant. Its wood shimmers slightly, greeting guests and their offerings with solemn silence.)

721401505.text: (Many Sacred Sakura petals lie scattered around this shrine, though it is not a natural scene. Instead, it seems more like someone intentionally scattered the Sakura Blooms here.)

721401506.text: Huh... There aren't any traces here, either.

721401509.text: Oh right. Chouji mentioned that his mom would present this offering to the shrine!

721401510.text: There are so many petals here, too... This can't be a coincidence.

721401511.text: Let's go back and tell him!

721401801.text: #{NICKNAME}, you're back. Did you bring any Crystal Marrow back?

721401804.text: Take your time. You can take a rest here too if you like.

721402108.text: But I'll keep looking for her. Only when I find her can any of these things have meaning.

721402201.text: Anyway. Thank you for your help! See you around!

721402408.text: But I'll keep looking for her. Only when I find her can any of these things have meaning.
